title: cutmesh meshDict
description: cutmesh configuration file (meshDict.json). Keys starting with _ or // are treated as comments.

domain.description: Watertight STL of the fluid domain. It can contain multiple solids, whose names become patch names. The path is relative to meshDict.json.

baseCellSize.description: Level 0 cell edge length. The size at level L is baseCellSize / 2^L.

patchTypes.description: Patch name → type (such as wall or patch). Omitted patches are treated as wall.

padding.description: Number of base cells to add around the STL bounding box

surfaceRefinement.description: Solid name → refinement level. Set default for all remaining solids.

featureLevel.description: Refinement level near sharp feature edges (null uses the maximum surface level)

featureAngle.description: Angle threshold for detecting feature edges

refinementRegions.description: Volume refinement regions. Refine inside each cylinder to its specified level.

point2.description: The other endpoint of the axis (must differ from point1)

origin.description: Center of rotation (rotating zones only, defaults to point1)

bufferLayers.description: Number of buffer cells at each level transition. Set to 1 to reduce the cell count.

gapRefinement.description: Refine walls to level where the fluid is thinner than thickness (for example, at slot tips or in narrow channels).

autoGapRefinement.description: Refine walls until cellsAcross cells fit in the gap to the opposing wall, up to maxLevel. Set to true to use the defaults.

cellsAcross.description: Number of cells across the gap

maxLevel.description: Maximum level (defaults to the maximum surface level + 2)

rotatingZones.description: List of rotating zones for MRF or sliding meshes. The zones must not overlap.

name.description: Zone name (cellZone name, with <name>_interface as the faceZone name)

cylinder.description: Rotating zone cylinder (specify either cylinder or stl)

point2.description: The other endpoint of the axis (must differ from point1)

origin.description: Center of rotation (rotating zones only, defaults to point1)

stl.description: Closed STL for the rotating zone (specify either cylinder or stl)

origin.description: Center of rotation for an STL-defined zone

axis.description: Rotation axis for an STL-defined zone (must be a nonzero vector)

surfaceLevel.description: Refinement level on the zone surface

omega.description: Angular velocity written to MRFProperties or dynamicMeshDict

nonRotatingPatches.description: Patches that stay stationary inside the zone

wallProximity.description: Refine the zone surface to level only where it lies within distance of the STL. Use this for an interface in a narrow gap.

ami.description: Set to true to split the interface into two sliding-mesh patches and write dynamicMeshDict.

conforming.description: Set to false to select the cellZone by cell centers without cutting the interface. For MRF only. Incompatible with ami.

snapTolerance.description: Distance for snapping vertices to surfaces, as a fraction of the cell edge length. Helps prevent sliver cells.

featureSnapTolerance.description: Distance for snapping to sharp STL edges and cylinder rims, as a fraction of the cell edge length

featureSnapMax.description: Experimental. Snap to feature edges within this distance and undo snaps that invalidate octree cells.

concaveSnapMax.description: Distance for snapping vertices on the solid side to sharp concave edges

mergeRatio.description: Merge cut cells below this fraction of the original hexahedron volume into a neighboring cell.

hangingSnap.description: Treatment of hanging vertices that do not reach the surface. free projects them directly onto it. constrained leaves them in place.

featureCaps.description: Align cut faces with sharp convex feature edges (domain / zone / both / false).

exactFeatureCut.description: Cut cells near sharp convex edges directly with STL planes. Works when featureCaps is domain or both.

mergeWallFaces.description: Combine nearly coplanar wall-face fragments of a cell into a single face.

fillThinGaps.description: Number of splits for cells with fluid inside but no corners in the fluid. Set to 0 to disable (Cartesian only).

fillThinWalls.description: Number of splits for cells with a thin solid wall inside but no corners in the solid (Cartesian only)

thinCutCells.description: Number of splits for cut cells with little remaining fluid and an adjacent finer cell (Cartesian only)

minRegionVolume.description: Remove disconnected fluid regions below this fraction of the total fluid volume.

checkLeaks.description: Check whether fluid cells are connected across a solid wall.

strictInput.description: Stop with an error if the STL has open or non-manifold edges.

volumeCheckTolerance.description: Warn if the volume difference between the mesh and STL exceeds this fraction.

writeMRFProperties.description: Write a constant/MRFProperties template when rotating zones are present.

openfoam.description: Sliding-mesh dialect. Use com for openfoam.com / ESI or org10, org11, or org12 for openfoam.org.

writeDynamicMeshDict.description: Write constant/dynamicMeshDict when an ami zone is present.

amiExactRims.description: Make the ami interface follow the zone rims exactly.

baseMesh.description: Base mesh. The default is Cartesian. Use cylindrical for concentric blocks around the rotation axis.

type.description: cartesian for a Cartesian grid or cylindrical for a cylindrical grid

zRange.description: Axial range [z0, z1] measured from origin. Defaults to the STL extent ± baseCellSize.

nz.description: Number of axial divisions (use nz or dz)

rOuter.description: Outer radius of the outermost block in the automatic layout. Defaults to the STL radius + 2/3 × cellSize.

cellSize.description: Target cell size for the automatic layout (defaults to the smaller of baseCellSize and dz)

maxSizeRatio.description: Maximum cell size ratio across block boundaries

core.description: Central square block for manual layout. Specify it together with blocks.

n.description: Number of divisions along an edge

blocks.description: Outward sequence of concentric blocks for manual layout. Specify it together with core.

addLayers.description: Add prismatic boundary layers to wall patches. Use {} for defaults or null to omit layers.

patches.description: List of patches to receive layers. null selects all patches of type wall.

expansionRatio.description: Ratio of successive layer thicknesses away from the wall

finalLayerThickness.description: Thickness of the innermost layer, expressed as a fraction of the local cell size if relativeSizes is enabled

relativeSizes.description: Specify thickness as a fraction of the local cell size.

minThickness.description: Omit layers where their total thickness would fall below this value.

maxNonOrtho.description: Treat cells above this non-orthogonality angle as invalid and reduce layer thickness there.

maxSkewness.description: Treat cells adjacent to faces above this skewness limit as invalid. null disables the check.

maxGapFraction.description: Limit total thickness to this fraction of the distance to the opposing wall. Set to 0 to disable.

maxThicknessSlope.description: Maximum change in total thickness along the wall, so layers taper gradually at their ends

minNormalCos.description: Omit layers where the cosine between vertex and face normals is below this threshold, at sharp convex edges.

wallNonOrthMargin.description: Allow the original wall face up to its boundary-face angle plus this margin.

cornerStretch.description: Move corner vertices by T/cos to maintain layer thickness T at corners.

mergeWallPoints.description: Merge wall vertices closer than this value times the local edge length. Set to 0 to disable.

concaveSlide.description: At concave corners, slide vertices that would intersect the other wall's layers along their own wall. null disables this.

nRings.description: Number of edges from the wall over which interior vertices are displaced

nSmooth.description: Number of Laplacian smoothing iterations for interior displacements

nIter.description: Number of iterations that halve layer thickness at invalid cells

nCollapseIter.description: Number of subsequent iterations that suppress layers
